This residual claims that no workflow file is in `allowed_files`, but lines 9–11 explicitly allow all three workflows modified by this commit. Because these workflows decide required-check execution, the false premise provides no compensating control for the declared workflow/environment-input risk; replace it with the actual mitigation, such as the decision tests and task-level diff audit. The repository requires reporting a residual row whose control does not mitigate its risk.
